summary.en: Former president Joseph Kabila has launched a new political-military front that incorporates the M23 rebels in eastern DR Congo. Erik Prince's security personnel were ambushed, resulting in the death of a former New Zealand special forces officer and wounds to former UFC fighter Tim Kennedy. The fighting intensifies around the M23 campaign as Kabila’s front joins the rebels. The UCDP recorded 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Tidligere president Joseph Kabila har lansert en ny politisk-militær front som innlemmer M23-opprørerne i Øst-DR Kongo. Erik Princes sikkerhetspersonell ble overfalt, noe som førte til at en tidligere New Zealand-spesialstyrkeoffiser døde og den tidligere UFC-utøveren Tim Kennedy ble såret. Kampene intensiveres rundt M23‑kampanjen ettersom Kabilas front slutter seg til opprørerne. UCDP registrerte 1 158 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
